Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely positions MoS₂ beyond its conventional cathode role, highlighting its multifunctional utility across cathodes, anodes, and electrolytes in aqueous zinc-ion batteries. item.title: Self-foaming sintering-resistant iron-tungsten powders enable high-cycle thermochemical hydrogen storage
item.description:
این مقاله پودرهای آهن-تنگستن خودکف‌ساز مقاوم به تف‌جوش را برای ذخیره‌سازی ترموشیمیایی هیدروژن با چرخه بالا معرفی می‌کند.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Fe-19W alloyed powders self-foam via tungsten gas-phase transport during redox cycling, solving decades-old sintering-induced capacity loss in iron powder beds. A kilogram-scale bed stores 43.8 g H2, retaining 93±3% capacity over 30 cycles (90 partial cycles). This enables robust, scalable, compact solid-state thermochemical hydrogen storage.
